description: Rig and animate a 2D game character from one picture. Give a public link to the image (PNG, JPG or WebP, a full-body character, best on a plain or transparent background). Returns a link that opens the GameShipKit 2D Character Rigging tool with the character already loaded: it finds the joints, cuts a humanoid into parts, adds bones and plays the moves you ask for. From there the user can tweak joints and export. Free: the full preview and idle and walk sprite sheets. Pro: every other move, all moves at once, and Godot 4, Unity 2D Animation and Spine rigs.

animations.description: Moves to play in the preview, in order. Default: idle, walk, attack, jump.

cut_parts.description: For humanoids: cut the picture into head, body, arms and legs so limbs bend at the joints.

facing.description: Which way the character in the picture faces.

image_url.description: Public http(s) link to the character image.

name.description: Short name for the exported files.

pixel_art.description: Keep sharp pixels for pixel art characters.

template.description: Skeleton: humanoid (people, robots), quad (four legs), wing (birds, dragons, bats), snake (snakes, fish, worms), simple (slimes, plants, items). Found automatically when left out.

name: rig_character
title: Rig a 2D character
